claims.text: Asthma: cornerstone of therapy,
claims.quote: prioritizes inhaled glucocorticoids as the cornerstone of therapy

claims.text: for long-term control of inflammation and symptoms.
claims.quote: Inhaled glucocorticoids, also referred to as inhaled corticosteroids (ICS), are generally indicated for long-term suppression, control, and reversal of inflammation and symptoms.

claims.text: Preferred reliever at every step is a low-dose ICS–beta-agonist combination (as needed for mild asthma; maintenance + reliever for moderate–severe persistent).
claims.quote: There is substantial evidence that the preferred reliever across all steps is a low-dose ICS–beta-agonist combination, used as needed for mild asthma and as both maintenance and reliever therapy for moderate-to-severe persistent asthma

claims.text: Adult starting doses (no prior ICS): fluticasone furoate 100 mcg once daily
claims.quote: The recommended starting dosage for adult and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older not on an inhaled corticosteroid (ICS) is fluticasone furoate 100 mcg (1 actuation of ARNUITY ELLIPTA 100 mcg) once daily by oral inhalation.

claims.text: (max 200 mcg);
claims.quote: The maximum recommended dosage in adult and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older is ARNUITY ELLIPTA 200 mcg once daily.

claims.text: beclomethasone 40–80 mcg twice daily
claims.quote: The recommended starting dosage for patients 12 years of age and older who are not on an inhaled corticosteroid is 40 to 80 mcg twice daily by oral inhalation, approximately 12 hours apart.

claims.text: (max 320 mcg twice daily);
claims.quote: The maximum recommended dosage for patients 12 years of age and older is 320 mcg twice daily.

claims.text: budesonide DPI 360 mcg twice daily (max 720 mcg twice daily);
claims.quote: For patients 18 years of age and older, the recommended starting dosage is 360 mcg twice daily. In some adult patients, a starting dose of 180 mcg twice daily may be adequate. The maximum dosage should not exceed 720 mcg twice daily

claims.text: mometasone HFA 100 mcg 2 inhalations twice daily
claims.quote: The recommended starting dosage for patients 12 years of age and older who are not on an inhaled corticosteroid is ASMANEX HFA 100 mcg, 2 inhalations twice daily.

claims.text: (max 800 mcg/day);
claims.quote: The maximum daily recommended dose is two inhalations of ASMANEX HFA 200 mcg twice daily (maximum of 800 mcg a day).

claims.text: ciclesonide 80 mcg twice daily if on bronchodilators alone (max 160 mcg twice daily).
claims.quote: Patients ≥ 12 years who received bronchodilators alone | 80 mcg twice daily | 160 mcg twice daily

claims.text: Once stable, titrate to the lowest effective dose.
claims.quote: After asthma stability has been achieved, it is desirable to titrate to the lowest effective dosage to reduce the possibility of side effects.

claims.text: Contraindicated as primary treatment of status asthmaticus or acute asthma needing intensive measures.
claims.quote: ASMANEX HFA is contraindicated in the primary treatment of status asthmaticus or other acute episodes of asthma where intensive measures are required.

claims.text: Caution: can worsen TB, fungal, bacterial, viral, parasitic or ocular HSV infection; chickenpox/measles can be severe or fatal in non-immune patients.
claims.quote: Immunosuppression: Potential worsening of existing tuberculosis, fungal, bacterial, viral, or parasitic infection; or ocular herpes simplex infections. More serious or even fatal course of chickenpox or measles can occur in susceptible patients.

claims.text: Switching from oral steroids: risk of adrenal insufficiency, taper the systemic steroid slowly.
claims.quote: Transferring patients from systemic corticosteroids: Risk of impaired adrenal function when transferring from oral steroids. Taper patients slowly from systemic corticosteroids if transferring to QVAR REDIHALER.

claims.text: Fluticasone is a CYP3A4 substrate: strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (eg, ketoconazole) raise exposure; use caution.
claims.quote: Fluticasone furoate is a substrate of CYP3A4. Concomitant administration of the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor ketoconazole increases the systemic exposure to fluticasone furoate. Caution should be exercised when considering the coadministration of ARNUITY ELLIPTA with ketoconazole and other known strong CYP3A4 inhibitors

claims.text: Check BMD at baseline and periodically;
claims.quote: Assess for decrease in bone mineral density initially and periodically thereafter.

claims.text: monitor growth in children;
claims.quote: Monitor growth of pediatric patients.

claims.text: consider ophthalmology referral with ocular symptoms or long-term use.
claims.quote: Consider referral to an ophthalmologist in patients who develop ocular symptoms or use ARNUITY ELLIPTA long term.

claims.text: Acute overdose rarely needs more than observation;
claims.quote: overdosage of fluticasone furoate is unlikely to require any treatment other than observation.

claims.text: chronic overdose can cause hypercorticism.
claims.quote: Chronic overdosage may result in signs/symptoms of hypercorticism
